title: The weeknight fridge
blurb: Chicken, ground turkey, eggs and a drawer of vegetables. Two people, 30-minute dinners.
short: Chicken, turkey, eggs and vegetables. Serves two.
alt: Illustration of an open fridge holding milk, yogurt, eggs, cheddar, chicken, ground turkey, tortillas, rice, spinach, tomatoes, broccoli, peppers, carrots, zucchini, lemons and avocados.

title: The vegetarian fridge
blurb: Tofu, eggs, feta, hummus and plenty of greens. Two people, no meat or fish.
short: Tofu, feta, hummus and greens. Vegetarian, serves two.
alt: Illustration of an open fridge holding tofu, eggs, yogurt, feta, hummus, milk, parmesan, spinach, kale, mushrooms, zucchini, peppers, tomatoes, cucumber, lemons, blueberries, basil and pita.

title: The high-protein fridge
blurb: Salmon, shrimp, cottage cheese and eggs. One person, pescatarian, 130 g of protein a day.
short: Salmon, shrimp and eggs. One person, high protein.
alt: Illustration of an open fridge holding salmon, shrimp, smoked salmon, eggs, cottage cheese, yogurt, asparagus, spinach, avocados, cucumber, tomatoes, lemons, limes, cilantro, corn tortillas, sweet potatoes, a red onion and jalapenos.
